tests.name: SQL references resolved by the cross-file pass

cases.title: a reference to a table or view defined in exactly one other file resolves inferred -- qualified or bare, whatever its case
several candidates leave the reference ambiguous with its candidates and no edge; a qualified name never matches a bare definition
a name no file defines is classed no-candidate (no-match), not not-attempted
a settle that commits the file defining a table resolves a waiting reference of an unchanged file
s9 t8 (ac2): SQL files indexed through IndexerService store a table or view per definition beside the document, and REFERENCES per foreign key and per relation a view selects from
a settle that commits the file defining a table resolves a reference waiting on it in an unchanged file

titles.title: a reference to a table or view defined in exactly one other file resolves inferred -- qualified or bare, whatever its case
several candidates leave the reference ambiguous with its candidates and no edge; a qualified name never matches a bare definition
a name no file defines is classed no-candidate (no-match), not not-attempted
a settle that commits the file defining a table resolves a waiting reference of an unchanged file
a table moved to another file: the settle for the two files re-links the reference of an unchanged file to its new place
a table renamed in its file: the settle classes the waiting reference no-candidate by its name
removing one of two definitions: the settle resolves the reference that was ambiguous between them
a view never answers its own reference; a REFERENCES row from a non-SQL entity is not attempted; a settle with no SQL file reads no SQL reference
a returned reference keeps the name the user wrote: a bare reference follows its table into another schema
a reference from a non-SQL entity whose target is removed still awaits the target id, as before
a returned reference comes back only under names the holder references: a CTE, a string, an alias or a comment is not one
without the SQL reader registered, a reference whose target is removed awaits the target id, as before
a holder whose statement names nothing that could mean the removed target: the reference awaits the target id
